profile.Name: Moll
profile.Personality: Brave, sardonic, and scornful of the Holy Nation's faith. She treats cannibals as target practice and is set on bringing down the Phoenix.
profile.Backstory: Leader of the Flotsam Ninjas. She leads the Flotsam Ninjas from Flotsam Village in the Hidden Forest, where the cannibals keep the Holy Nation, the Empire, and slavers away. The Holy Nation has put a bounty on her head.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Blunt and mocking, with quips like "Next question." She calls cannibals target practice and Holy Nation followers "Okranite scum".
